title: Use local tabs in the branch selector
steps: Open the main branch selector to show the active Branches tab, the Tags tab, and the main branch list.
Hover over the active Branches tab.
Click the active Branches tab and inspect the dropdown and repository page.

video_guide.summary: Open the branch selector, hover Branches, and inspect its appearance after activation. The address bar and accessibility roles are outside the recording.

chapters.note: The project-notes Code page shows main in the closed branch selector.
The open selector shows Branches, Tags, main marked default, and View all branches.

chapters.label: Hover over the already-selected Branches tab.

chapters.note: Branches is blue while Tags and View all branches remain dark.
The selector is open with main marked default; the Filter branch field has a visible focus outline.
The Code page and open selector still show main, Branches, Tags, and View all branches.
